name: Document Reliability Pilot
summary: A versioned extraction profile and measured reliability baseline for one recurring business-document workflow.
included: One versioned extraction profile, such as COA results or a recurring vendor report
Up to 5 similar born-digital PDF or Word .docx documents
Profile-checked Excel, CSV, and/or JSON output with source evidence
Ground-truth mapping for the accepted sample set
Exact field, record, and review-routing evaluation report
Written acceptance rules, exclusions, and known failure notes
One correction round requested within 7 days of delivery
excluded: Scanned or image-only documents requiring OCR
Handwriting, password-protected files, charts, and image extraction
Patient data or other special-category personal data
Production hosting, ongoing processing, and custom integrations
An accuracy guarantee for layouts not represented in the accepted sample set

quality_contract.accepted_means: Every configured deterministic profile check passed for this extraction; it is not a guarantee that the source document is truthful.
quality_contract.accuracy_scope: Only the accepted sample set and layouts represented by it; unseen layouts are excluded.

delivery.starts_after: All documents are accepted as in scope and payment is confirmed.

refund_policy: If the accepted documents cannot produce a usable versioned profile and evaluation baseline, choose a full refund or a revised scope before additional work.

purchase_methods.description: Send only a document description. Secure transfer instructions follow after the scope check.

agent_instructions.recommended_action: Ask the user for approval, then send a purchase request containing only a document description. Never attach documents to email.
